objective: Complete FC10 database-load coverage on the frozen local PostgreSQL queue workload without changing the queue, job count, handler delay or worker levels.

baseline.description: PostgreSQL claim/lease queue with one worker.

execution_order: Deterministic balanced rotation of worker levels across repetitions.

instrumentation.container_scope: The pgvector PostgreSQL container cgroup v2 only; it excludes the Python evaluator and Docker Desktop host overhead.
instrumentation.cpu_and_io: Read cumulative cpu.stat and io.stat immediately before and after each repetition and report non-negative deltas.
instrumentation.memory: Poll memory.current during each workload and report the largest observed value; polling overhead is present in every arm.
instrumentation.postgres: Read pg_stat_database for current_database() before and after each repetition and report non-negative counter deltas.

intervals.method: Deterministic 10000-resample percentile bootstrap of paired candidate-minus-baseline deltas.

reporting: Publish every row and, for each declared metric, the one-worker baseline, each candidate, absolute and relative delta, paired 95% interval, denominator and local-only scope. Do not reinterpret resource increase as benefit.
